title: Puthoff's paper on ultraterrestrials surviving a cataclysm

tellings.quote: He's written a paper on ultraterrestrials. So, beings that could have died off in a cataclysm.
Halputo off has a hypothesis called the ultraterrestrial hypothesis which is that um the beings the non-human intelligence are a holdover from a civilization that existed before the ice age
tellings.difference: Names it the ultraterrestrial hypothesis and dates the civilization to before the Ice Age, without mentioning a paper.
tellings.link_reason: Same Puthoff idea: ultraterrestrials as survivors of an earlier civilization wiped out by a cataclysm.

plain: The physicist Hal Puthoff, Michels says, has an idea he calls the ultraterrestrial hypothesis: that the non-human intelligences behind UFOs are a holdover from an earlier civilization on Earth that may have been wiped out in a cataclysm, possibly living on in places like underwater or moon bases. Michels tells it twice: once as a paper Puthoff wrote, once as a hypothesis dating that civilization to before the Ice Age. If true, the visitors would not be from space at all but older than us, from here.
